answer: Sybil resistance is enforced over a reputation horizon: each EigenTrust score decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, honestly reciprocated service to accumulate durable weight. In the reciprocity-weighted trust trellis, freshly spawned identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality, regardless of self-reports or collusion, and therefore cannot pass consensus; even saffron-labeled newcomers must first earn support through time.
